research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Moxion Power is engaged in developing mobile power unit systems, as described in Battery module system for mobile power station, which details conductor assemblies for battery cells, and Thermal system strategy for mobile power units, which discusses integrating energy sources and power electronics. Their work also includes safety structures, battery mounting and retention systems, embedded heating for battery modules, and fleet management for all-electric mobile power units, highlighting advancements in zero-emission generator technology.
